# Race Condition Detection with ThreadSanitizer (TSan)

Detecting data races in multithreaded C++, Go, and Rust using ThreadSanitizer (TSan) during automated test execution.

## Invariants
- COMPILE_WITH_THREAD_SANITIZER_ENABLED
- ZERO_DATA_RACE_WARNINGS_TOLERATED
- TEST_UNDER_MAXIMUM_THREAD_CONTENTION
